known.via: English Wikipedia "Valle de la Orotava" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation on the northwestern coast of Tenerife, covering La Orotava, Puerto de la Cruz and Los Realejos. It gained its DO in 1995, and its rules allow still, sparkling and liqueur wines from local grapes such as Listán Blanco and Negramoll.
